title: Palmer Penguins for Python
text:
What I have Done
Dataset: I chose the Palmer Penguins dataset, which contains information about penguins observed at Palmer Station in Antarctica. The dataset includes measurements such as species, island, bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass, sex, and year. I used this dataset to explore how body mass differs across penguin species.
Discovery: After removing the missing values, I sorted the penguins by body mass and calculated the average body mass for each species using Python. The results show that Gentoo penguins had the highest average body mass at about 5092 g, while Adelie and Chinstrap penguins had similar average body masses of about 3706 g and 3733 g, respectively.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
My first weeks in MDS
Starting MDS was a little different from what I had imagined. Due to visa delays, I unfortunately missed orientation and arrived a week after the program had already started. So, there was definitely a lot to take in all at once. Walking into a new program and trying to catch up on everything was overwhelming, but also exciting.
What made the experience much easier was how welcoming everyone has been. My classmates have been incredibly kind and helpful, and the professors have been understanding and supportive as I catch up. Even though I started later than everyone else, I’ve already felt like I’m part of the community, which has made a stressful first day feel a lot more manageable.
I’m still figuring out the pace of the program and everything that comes with starting MDS, but I’m excited to see where the next few months take me. It’s definitely been a slightly unusual start, but I’m looking forward to catching up, meeting more people, and getting into the rhythm of the program.
